subject: Rate card access & NDA for Acme Data - Redwood hosted API
messages:
From: Jared Liu <jared.liu@acmedata.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nora Patel <nora.patel@acmedata.com>, procurement@acmedata.com
Date: 2026-11-22 09:12 PST
Subject: Request: hosted API rate card + NDA

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — we ran the internal intake and Procurement/Legal asked for your latest hosted API rate card and a mutual NDA before they circulate pricing to the finance team. Can you share the most recent rate card PDF and confirm who will sign the NDA (DocuSign preferred)? We have a potential committed usage discussion, so we'll want to understand any volume-based discounts.

High level: our expected first-year consumption is ~2.5B tokens (mix of chat and inference), but could scale. We need baseline per-token units and any committed discounts or annual commitments you typically offer. Also include any notes on reserved capacity vs hosted pricing.

If easier, send both the rate card and NDA and we can route for signature.

Thanks,
Jared Liu
Sr. Sourcing Manager, Acme Data Inc

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Liu <jared.liu@acmedata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22 09:42 PST
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API rate card + NDA

Jared — thanks, happy to get this moving.

Attached: Mutual_NDA_Acme_signed_stub.pdf (please see note below) and Redwood_Ratecard_v1.2.pdf (baseline hosted tiers + reserved options).

Quick notes up front:
- For ~2.5B tokens we typically propose a committed tier that layers a 20% discount off list hosted rates, plus an additional 5% for an annual prepay.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity) becomes cost-effective if you need sustained high throughput and predictable latency; we can model both.
- Ratecard v1.2 includes quantization guidance and an example cost model for chat vs single-turn generation.

DocuSign: We can sign mutual NDAs electronically. For speed, I've attached a signed stub of the NDA from Legal to show we agree to mutual terms; we'll complete DocuSign if your team sends the envelope.

Marissa (cc) — can you own the follow-up modeling and provide a quick committed-pricing worksheet keyed to 2.5B tokens and a 12-month prepay? Karthik, please add any standard procurement hoops we should flag to Acme.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Ratecard_v1.2.pdf (application/pdf, 182KB) ; Mutual_NDA_Acme_signed.pdf (application/pdf, 54KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Liu <jared.liu@acmedata.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22 11:05 PST
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API rate card + NDA

Hi Jared — looping back with the high-level committed pricing worksheet attached and a short summary below.

Summary (12-month commitment, 2.5B tokens):
- List hosted rate (chat-equivalent token): $0.0008/token
- Committed discount (20%): $0.00064/token
- Prepay incentive (5% off committed): $0.000608/token (effective)
- Estimated monthly burn: ~208M tokens => $126,464/month at effective rate
- One-time onboarding credit for enterprise pilot: $10k (applied to month 1)

Notes:
- The ratecard PDF describes additional line-items (embedding units, fine-tune prep charges).
- Reserved (Dedicated) pricing: we can provide a custom reserved quote if low-latency SLOs and per-request QoS are primary; this usually requires a 12–24 month commitment and an annual platform fee.

Next steps: if Legal is good with the NDA we can accept DocuSign, then I'll drop a signed ratecard + commitment proposal. Also happy to run a 30-minute pricing model review with your finance team this week.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: ACME_Pricing_Worksheet_2.5B_tokens.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48KB)

From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@acmedata.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jared Liu <jared.liu@acmedata.com>, procurement@acmedata.com
Date: 2026-11-23 14:48 PST
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API rate card + NDA

Thanks Hannah/Marissa — we received the NDA stub and the ratecard PDF. Legal prefers us to send the DocuSign envelope to your Legal contact; I will route it now. A couple of clarifying questions before signature:

1) Does the committed discount apply uniformly across chat and single-turn generation, or do you differentiate by model family?
2) Can you confirm whether embeddings are billed per 1K vectors or per token in your worksheet?
3) For prepay incentives, do you accept monthly installment billing or is it a single up-front invoice?

If those are straightforward, we'll send the DocuSign and procurement will prepare the PO. Please confirm who the signer should be on Redwood's side (Legal or Sales is fine).

Regards,
Nora Patel
Senior Counsel, Acme Data Inc
